description:
Extreme Power For Serious Riders – The TD02 electric dirt bike delivers powerful off-road performance with a 6000W peak motor and up to 120Nm of torque, providing strong acceleration, confident hill climbing, and responsive control across challenging terrain. Reaches speeds up to 56 MPH under suitable riding conditions, making it ideal for trail riding, outdoor exploration, and demanding adventures.
Long-Range Removable Battery – Ride farther with the 72V 30Ah removable battery, delivering up to 50 miles of range depending on terrain, rider weight, and riding mode. The removable design allows convenient charging at home, garage, or workplace, keeping your TD02 ready for your next ride.
Engineered For Real Off-Road Terrain – Built with a durable high-carbon steel frame, front spring suspension, and 19" front / 17" rear off-road wheels, the TD02 delivers excellent stability, traction, and control on dirt, gravel, forest trails, and rugged mountain paths. The suspension system and aggressive tire setup help handle inclines up to 35° with confidence.
Confident Control And Safety – Equipped with front and rear hydraulic disc brakes and large 203mm rotors, the TD02 delivers powerful and responsive stopping performance for demanding off-road riding. Integrated LED headlights, daytime running lights, turn signals, and brake lights improve visibility and rider confidence during both daytime and nighttime rides.
Smart Riding Technology – Unlock your TD02 instantly with NFC keyless technology and monitor essential ride information through the full-color LCD display. Easily check speed, battery level, and riding data at a glance for a more convenient and connected riding experience.
Built To Handle Every Adventure – Designed for serious riders, the TD02 features a reinforced high-carbon steel frame, IPX5 water-resistant protection, and a 440 lbs load capacity. Combining durable construction with performance-focused components, it is built for trail riding, outdoor exploration, and recreational off-road adventures.
